# TurboTax Blog

> TurboTax Blog is your go-to resource for tax guidance, deductions, credits, and refund strategies to maximize your returns.

The TurboTax Blog provides comprehensive tax guidance covering deductions, credits, filing tips, and personal finance strategies. It serves both English and Spanish-speaking audiences with expert advice from CPAs and tax professionals, including coverage of emerging tax topics like cryptocurrency and creator income.

## Key Topics

- Tax Deductions
- Tax Credits
- Tax Refunds
- Tax Filing
- Tax Planning
- Self-Employment Taxes
- Cryptocurrency Taxes
- Tax Credits and Deductions
- IRS
- Tax Law Changes
- Capital Gains
- Home Office Deduction
- Tax Tips
- Personal Finance
- TurboTax

## Tax Deductions & Credits

- [What's the Difference Between a Deduction and a Credit?](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-deductions-and-credits-2/i-finally-understand-the-difference-between-tax-credits-and-deductions-heres-what-clicked-141578): Explains the difference between tax deductions and credits for beginners.
- [Enough Deductions to Itemize? How to Know](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-deductions-and-credits-2/i-finally-have-enough-deductions-to-itemize-heres-how-to-know-if-you-should-too-141497): Guide comparing itemized vs. standard deductions for tax planning.
- [Home Office Deduction: Do You Qualify?](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-deductions-and-credits-2/the-audit-myth-that-stopped-me-from-claiming-my-home-office-142747): Explains home office deduction eligibility and exclusive use requirements.

## Tax Refunds & Filing

- [Latest Posts](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/latest-posts): Latest blog posts on tax help, deductions, and personal finance topics.
- [Why Everyone Is Talking About Bigger Refunds](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-news/why-everyone-is-talking-about-bigger-refunds-and-what-it-means-for-your-wallet-142200): News on IRS refund trends and how tax law changes affect refund amounts.
- [I Filed Taxes What's Next](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/i-filed-taxes-whats-next-old): Post-filing guide with tax planning and next-year preparation resources.
- [Free Tax Reform Calculator](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-reform/tax-reform-calculator-120487): Interactive calculator showing tax law changes and refund impact estimates.

## Tax Debt & Payment Plans

- [What to Do If You Owe Taxes This Year](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-help/i-owe-taxes-this-year-and-im-freaking-out-heres-my-plan-142290): Guidance on understanding tax debt and exploring IRS payment plan options.
- [I Owed the IRS. Here's What I Learned About Payment Plans](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-help/i-was-scared-of-the-irs-then-i-learned-about-payment-plans-142404): Explains IRS payment plans and installment agreement options for tax debt.

## Specialized Income & Investments

- [Creator Tax Center](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/creator-tax-center): Tax guidance hub for content creators covering deductions and self-employment taxes.
- [Investments Hub](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/hub/investments): Hub covering investment taxes, capital gains, and retirement account taxation.
- [Crypto Tax Report: How to Organize Multiple Wallets](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/cryptocurrency/my-crypto-wallets-are-a-mess-heres-how-i-generated-my-tax-report-141794): Guide to consolidating crypto wallet activity and generating tax reports.
- [I Sold on Poshmark. Do I Owe Taxes on Resale Income?](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/income/i-sold-stuff-on-poshmark-do-i-owe-taxes-142514): Covers Poshmark resale income taxation and the $400 IRS reporting rule.
- [Sports Betting Winnings: What to Do at Tax Time](https://blog.turbotax.intuit.com/tax-help/i-won-money-on-a-sports-app-during-the-big-game-now-what-142930): Guide on reporting sports betting winnings and Form W-2G requirements.
